description: Source code for kernel fatal error handling on ARM Cortex-M and Cortex-R architectures in Zephyr OS, including error reporting, exception dumping, and oops handling.

methods.name: esf_dump
methods.description: Dumps the contents of the exception stack frame for debugging purposes.

methods.name: z_arm_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles a fatal error, optionally dumping exception info.

methods.name: z_do_kernel_oops
methods.description: Handles a kernel oops or panic, processes exception frame and calls fatal error handler.

methods.name: arch_syscall_oops
methods.description: Handles a system call oops, constructs an exception stack frame and triggers fatal error.
